description: Get the organization's credit balance: credits remaining, credits per billing cycle, and when the cycle resets. Free. Call it before a large run to check that the credits cover it. The balance can lag by up to 60 seconds.
name: get_credits

cycleResetsAt.description: When the billing cycle ends and the credits reset (ISO 8601). Null on the free tier.

perCycle.description: Credits granted per billing cycle. Null on the free tier.

title: Get the credit balance
